SCOPE OF SUPPLY 1.1 The scope of the contract shall include complete supply, installation, integration, commissioning, testing and de monstration of the complete equipment/project at the Buyer’s site, as per the technical specifications/WCOR and ot her requirements stipulated in the GeM Bid. 1.2 The quoted price shall be deemed to include all components, accessories, software, cables, interconnections, sta ndard tools, installation, commissioning and other items/services necessary for making the complete system operati onal, unless specifically excluded in the bid. 2. INSTALLATION, COMMISSIONING AND ACCEPTANCE 2.1 The successful bidder shall undertake complete installation and commissioning at the Buyer’s designated site. 2.2 Installation and commissioning shall include system integration, configuration, calibration, functional checks and demonstration of all specified capabilities. 2.3 The bidder shall provide all manpower, tools, accessories and technical assistance required for installation and co

2.3 The bidder shall provide all manpower, tools, accessories and technical assistance required for installation and co mmissioning. 2.4 The equipment/project shall be considered complete only after successful completion of the prescribed Acceptan ce Test Procedure (ATP) and certification/acceptance by the Buyer. 2.5 The bidder shall rectify, at no additional cost to the Buyer, any deficiencies/failures observed during installation, commissioning or ATP. 3. ACCEPTANCE TEST PROCEDURE (ATP) 3.1 Acceptance of the complete project shall be based on successful demonstration and verification of the specified technical parameters and functional capabilities. 3.2 The ATP shall be conducted at the Buyer’s site after completion of installation and commissioning. 3.3 The successful bidder shall provide necessary technical personnel, test equipment, instruments, accessories and documentation required for conducting the ATP. 3.4 In case any parameter/capability is not demonstrated successfully during ATP, the bidder shall rectify the deficie ncy and repeat the relevant test at no additional cost to the Buyer. 3.5 Final acceptance shall be accorded only after satisfactory completion of the ATP. 4. PAYMENT TERMS 4.1 Payment shall be released after completion of the complete project, successful installation and commissioning a nd satisfactory completion of the Acceptance Test Procedure (ATP), subject to submission and acceptance of all req uired documents and fulfilment of applicable GeM contractual conditions. 4.2 No payment shall be considered due merely on delivery of individual equipment/components where the project r equires complete integration, installation and commissioning. 4.3 Payment shall otherwise be governed by the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions and resultant contra ct. 5. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION / WCOR COMPLIANCE 5.1 The bidder shall submit a complete point-by-point compliance statement against all technical specifications, para meters and requirements specified in the GeM Bid/WCOR. 5.2 The bidder shall clearly indicate “Complied / Not Complied” against every parameter and shall mention the offer ed make, model, specification and relevant supporting document/reference wherever applicable. 5.3 The bidder shall not make any deviation from the approved technical specifications without clearly declaring the same in the compliance statement. 5.4 Compliance shall be supported by authentic OEM technical literature, datasheets, brochures, manuals or other r elevant documents wherever required. 5.5 Mere submission of a general catalogue without establishing compliance against the specified parameters may n ot be considered sufficient for technical evaluation. 5.6 The Buyer reserves the right to seek clarification/supporting technical documents during evaluation, wherever co nsidered necessary, in accordance with applicable GeM provisions. 6. NON-CHINESE EQUIPMENT / ORIGIN CERTIFICATE 6.1 The bidder shall submit a certificate/declaration confirming the country of origin of the equipment and major sub -systems/components offered against the bid. 6.2 The bidder/OEM shall specifically declare that the offered equipment is not of Chinese origin, wherever such requ irement is applicable to the procurement. 6.3 The certificate shall be issued on the bidder/OEM’s official letterhead and duly signed by the authorised signator y. 6.4 The bidder shall provide details of the manufacturer and country of origin for the major equipment/sub-systems

wherever requested by the Buyer. 6.5 Any false declaration or concealment of the country of origin shall make the bidder liable for action as per applic able Government/GeM rules and contractual provisions. 7. DEFENCE INDUSTRIAL LICENCE / LICENSING REQUIREMENT (If applicable) 7.1 Wherever the equipment/system or any component thereof falls under an item requiring a Defence Industrial Lic ence or any other statutory/mandatory licence/approval, the bidder/OEM shall possess the requisite valid licence/ap proval. 7.2 A copy of the valid licence/approval shall be uploaded with the bid wherever applicable. 7.3 In case no such licence is applicable to the offered equipment, the bidder shall submit a declaration to this effect , wherever required. 8. GFR 144 (XI) COMPLIANCE 8.1 The bidder shall submit a duly signed GFR 144(xi) Compliance Certificate in accordance with the applicable Gov ernment of India provisions relating to restrictions on procurement from bidders of countries sharing a land border w ith India. 8.2 The bidder shall certify its eligibility under the applicable provisions of GFR 144(xi) and the relevant Government orders/instructions. 8.3 Where registration with the competent authority is applicable, the bidder shall submit valid documentary eviden ce of such registration. 8.4 The declaration shall be submitted on the bidder’s official letterhead and signed by the authorised signatory. The prescribed declaration format is placed at Annexure-B. 9. BID SECURITY DECLARATION 9.1 Wherever a bidder is eligible for exemption from Bid Security/EMD under applicable GeM/Government provisions , the bidder shall submit a duly signed Bid Security Declaration in the format placed at Annexure-A, along with valid documentary evidence supporting its eligibility for such exemption. 9.2 Submission of a Bid Security Declaration shall not, by itself, establish entitlement to Bid Security/EMD exemption . 9.3 Bidders who are not eligible for exemption shall comply with the Bid Security/EMD requirements specified in the GeM Bid. 9.4 The Bid Security Declaration shall remain binding for the period specified under the applicable bid/GeM condition s. 10. TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION The successful bidder shall provide, as applicable: (a) User/Operating Manuals; (b) Maintenance Manuals; (c) Technical Datasheets; (d) System configuration details; (e) Calibration/Test Certificates, wherever applicable; (f) Warranty Certificate; (g) Software licences and documentation, wherever applicable; and (h) Other documents required for operation and maintenance of the system.
